description: This file defines the main entry point and core setup for a SwiftUI-based Notes app. It sets up dependency injection, initializes core components like persistence, repository, sync engine, and network monitor, and defines the app's main scene with lifecycle events to start synchronization. It also contains a static method for creating a remote API interface, configurable for development or production environments.

classes.name: NotesAppApp
classes.description: Main application entry point conforming to SwiftUI's App protocol, responsible for app initialization, scene management, dependency setup, and lifecycle handling.

classes.name: AppEnvironment
classes.description: A struct holding shared long-lived dependencies for the app, such as persistence controller, repository, sync engine, and network monitor.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the app, setting up core components and dependency injection.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main scene of the app, composing the main view and handling app lifecycle events.

methods.name: makeRemoteNotesAPI
methods.description: Factory method to create a RemoteNotesAPI instance, configurable to return mock or real implementations depending on build configuration or URL setting.
